# KKOOAPP

> Tanzania super-app for shopping, food, groceries, pharmacy, rides, parcels, and hotels. Escrow checkout, live tracking, and rewards for buyers, sellers, and riders.

KKOO (also KkooApp) is a commerce and delivery platform for East Africa. Shop on the web or mobile apps. Sellers run catalog, orders, POS, and payouts. Riders handle delivery and ride jobs.

Contact: +255 788 419 991. Support: https://kkooapp.co.tz/support

## Buyer

- [Home](https://kkooapp.co.tz/): Marketplace overview and app download
- [Marketplace](https://kkooapp.co.tz/market): Browse and buy products
- [Food](https://kkooapp.co.tz/eats): Restaurant and meal delivery
- [Groceries](https://kkooapp.co.tz/grocery): Grocery delivery
- [Pharmacy](https://kkooapp.co.tz/pharmacy): Pharmacy delivery
- [Rides](https://kkooapp.co.tz/ride): Ride hailing
- [Send / parcels](https://kkooapp.co.tz/send): Buy-for-me and parcel delivery
- [Hotels](https://kkooapp.co.tz/booking): Hotel and venue booking
- [Discover](https://kkooapp.co.tz/discover): Places and services nearby
- [Get started](https://kkooapp.co.tz/get-started): Create an account
- [Personal](https://kkooapp.co.tz/personal): For everyday buyers
